WITH total_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as total_amount
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped')
),
digital_sales AS (
    SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price) as digital_amount
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id
    JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.id
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped') AND c.name = '数码'
)
SELECT 
    total_amount as total_sales,
    digital_amount as digital_category_sales,
    (digital_amount * 100.0 / total_amount) as percentage
FROM total_sales, digital_sales;
